title: Report of access-conformance
description: The JSON result of a run of access-conformance. It has the role, the target, the counts and one entry for each case. The members and their order are stable.

role.description: The implementation that the run tested.

target.description: The URL of the target, as the option --url gave it. It is null when the runner started fake-pdp.

summary.description: The counts of the run. The count of cases is the sum of the four other counts.

cases.description: The number of cases in the run.

failed.description: The cases that failed. A failed case of a MUST rule gives the exit code 1.

skipped.description: The cases that do not apply to the target.

warned.description: The cases of a SHOULD rule that failed. They do not change the exit code.

cases.description: One entry for each case, in the order of the run.

paragraphs.description: The paragraphs that the case tests.

status.description: The result. A case of a SHOULD rule that fails has the status warn.

reason.description: Why the runner skipped the case. It is null for the other statuses.

failures.description: The failed checks. The list is empty for a case that passed or that the runner skipped.

step.description: The name of the step, or null for a failure of the case.

message.description: What went wrong, with the expected value and the value found.

cases.title: The PEP sends the subject with the type user and the claim sub as the id.
A false answer with budget_exceeded gives HTTP 429 with the header Retry-After.

failures.step: Use of an action that lists a budget
